instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Sign a person up for an email course after they agreed to it, keep their consent in my records, send the first lesson now and queue the others", and give it email; consent; course; provider.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:sign-someone-up-for-an-email-course and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give email, consent (true only when the person agreed in the words of course.consent_text), course (id, public_origin as an https site root, checkout_url, from, mailing_address, consent_text, consent_version and 2 to 12 lessons { delay_hours, subject, article_url, text_lines, html_lines } where every lesson carries {{unsubscribeUrl}} and {{mailingAddress}} and the first has delay_hours 0), source (where they signed up, optional) and provider (resend).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: email-course-subscription (records:read, records:write); email-course-token (records:read, records:write); contact-point (records:read, records:write); email-lesson-due (records:write).
